slides.title: The Call Was Already Over. The Review Had to Be Fair.
slides.subtitle: An admissions team's calling platform, read on 28 September 2026
slides.caption: A calling platform sees every call it places. It cannot see the ones staff placed by hand through the CRM's own dialer, and those are the calls a lead remembers.

slides.title: Go and get the calls nobody logged.
slides.subtitle: Searched on a schedule, gated on two things at once
slides.caption: A scheduled scan asks the vendor for calls this system never placed, skips any it has examined, and decides whether each connected: the vendor's status, and twenty seconds.
The page before the scan has ever run, on a keyless local copy of the platform, with invented rows. It is off by default, because examining a call spends credit.

slides.title: Get the words, two ways.
slides.subtitle: The vendor's transcript, or transcribe the recording
slides.caption: Where the vendor has a transcript, the job takes it. Where it does not, it transcribes the recording. 5,147 of 6,260 came from the fallback.

slides.title: Ask the model last.
slides.subtitle: Tags, three picklist fields, an enrolment date, then this system's own history
slides.caption: Sales or support is decided by four deterministic signals before a model is asked. The first of them, the vendor's tags, decided 6,109 of 6,257.
Three near-duplicate vendor columns were kept on every row, to settle from data which one was authoritative. 0 of 8,820 carry a value in any of them. On a keyless local copy, with invented rows.

rows: rows carry a value in any of the three vendor fields kept to settle the question from data
classifications decided by the tags alone, with no model call spent
examined calls produced a score, and every remaining row says why it did not
slides.caption: Read from the platform's own tables on 28 September 2026, each figure with the number it is out of. No transcript, summary or flag text is quoted.
Every examined call lands in exactly one of four branches, so a missing score is explained by the row. On a keyless local copy of the platform, with invented rows.

slides.title: A flag is a label, not a review.
slides.subtitle: Stored, and never rendered
slides.caption: The model writes a flag; nothing records anyone opening the row. The five dimensions behind each score are stored and never rendered. The rows with no score make the rest trustworthy.
